'''Lei Cheung''' is a ship Engineer based at '''[[Trader's Rest]]''' in the '''[[Laksak]]''' system. Raised among tramp traders, he learned engineering through the family trade and developed an affinity for shield technology. His workshop remains part of the family's scrapping and rebuilding operation.<ref name="edwiki-lei">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Lei_Cheung Lei Cheung], Elite Dangerous Wiki. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

Lei provides '''Grade 5''' engineering for [[Shield Generator|Shield Generators]], [[Sensors]], and [[Detailed Surface Scanner|Detailed Surface Scanners]]. His [[Shield Booster]] services reach Grade 3.<ref name="inara-lei">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/10/ Lei Cheung — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

== Location ==

* '''System:''' [[Laksak]]
* '''Body:''' Laksak A 1
* '''Facility:''' [[Trader's Rest]]
* '''Engineer scope:''' Ship modules, shields, and sensors
* '''Referral required:''' [[The Dweller]]
* '''System permit required:''' No

== Access requirements ==

Access to Lei Cheung has three direct requirements:<ref name="inara-lei" /><ref name="edwiki-lei" />

# Reach '''Grade 3 access''' and progress at least one-third of the way toward Grade 4 with [[The Dweller]] to receive his referral.
# Trade at least '''50 unique commodity markets'''.
# Deliver '''200 units of [[Gold]]''' to Trader's Rest.

The referral reveals Lei Cheung, but it does not complete his market-trading requirement or Gold contribution. Gold is a cargo commodity rather than an Engineering material, so each unit occupies cargo space.

For market counting, commodity sourcing, delivery planning, and the complete ordered process, see [[Unlocking Lei Cheung]].

== Workshop reputation ==

Reputation with Lei Cheung increases by:<ref name="inara-lei" />

* crafting modifications at his workshop; or
* selling commodities at Trader's Rest.

Higher reputation opens the grades that Lei supports. INARA notes that station services may not appear immediately after the first unlock; beginning a new game session can make those services available.<ref name="inara-lei" />

== Engineering services ==

The maximum grade is specific to each module family.<ref name="inara-lei" /><ref name="edwiki-lei" />

The available modification families, effects, trade-offs, and recipes belong to [[Engineering Blueprints]]. Compatible secondary modifications for Shield Generators and Shield Boosters belong to [[Experimental Effects]].

=== Operations-era services ===

Live adds '''Long Range Detailed''' for compatible Merc Detailed Surface Scanners. The blueprint trades increased mass and power draw for a larger probe radius, and Lei can apply it through Grade 5.<ref name="frontier-operations">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/updates/4-4-0-0 Elite Dangerous: Operations — Update Notes], Frontier Developments, 30 June 2026. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref><ref name="inara-dss-long">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/205/ Detailed Surface Scanner — Long Range Detailed], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

This service is not part of Legacy Engineering. Its individual modifiers, costs, and module compatibility belong to the corresponding [[Engineering Blueprints|Blueprint]] record.

== Blueprint pinning and remote work ==

After sufficient reputation has been earned, one Lei Cheung blueprint can be pinned for use through [[Remote Engineering]]. A pinned blueprint cannot exceed the grade he offers, and Experimental Effects still require an appropriate workshop visit.

== Direct referral ==

Lei Cheung introduces '''[[Ram Tah]]''' after the Commander reaches Grade 3 access and progresses approximately one-third of the way toward Grade 4 with him. Ram Tah's current Engineer record identifies Lei as his prerequisite Engineer.<ref name="inara-ram">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/18/ Ram Tah — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

The referral reveals Ram Tah; it does not satisfy his own meeting or unlock requirements. His location, requirements, services, and place in the referral network belong to [[Ram Tah|his article]]. For the complete network, see [[Engineer Unlock Guide]].
